description: fs.watch on a directory and on a file, as Node 22 reports it on Linux (inotify): create, append, overwrite, chmod, rename, mkdir, a nested write it doesn't see, unlink, rmdir, the watched file changed and removed; 'buffer' and 'hex' filenames; close and 'close'; ref/unref; getActiveResourcesInfo's FSEventWrap; ENOENT and the argument errors; an AbortSignal; persistent: false and unref() let the program end
